type: actual local structural and syntax validation; not an agent rollout

configuration.scope: syntax compilation, documented local file references, git whitespace checks

checks.command:
python3 -c 'import re
from pathlib import Path
for filename in ("README.md", "results/README.md"):
    source = Path(filename)
    for target in re.findall(r"\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)", source.read_text()):
        path = source.parent / target
        assert path.exists(), f"{source}: missing {target}"
print("All documented local file references resolve.")
'
